CVE-2026-117556.title: zchunk before 1.5.5 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerabil ...
CVE-2026-117556.description: zchunk before 1.5.5 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in read_preface() in src/lib/header.c that passes the total header length instead of remaining bytes to compint parsing functions. Attackers can supply a crafted .zck file whose header ends inside a compressed integer, causing reads past the heap header buffer and crashing the application.
